_comment: Allowlist of Supabase database linter findings that are reviewed and accepted. CI fails on any finding NOT in this list. Each entry is matched on (name, level, metadata.schema, metadata.name) so adding a new policy/function with the same name as an allowlisted one will still be detected.

allowed.name: function_search_path_mutable
allowed.reason: Trigger-only function; search_path is set inside the function body.

allowed.name: auth_otp_long_expiry
allowed.reason: OTP expiry left at provider default for now; tracked separately.

allowed.reason: HaveIBeenPwned check disabled in Lovable Cloud; tracked separately.
